lane: Billing lot 1: RevenueCat webhook writes the premium entitlement; server reads one shared helper
goal: Prepare the server side of selling Premium on Google Play through RevenueCat (Owner decision: sell in the first Play build, one entitlement named premium). A new service-only Edge Function receives RevenueCat webhooks, checks a shared secret in the Authorization header, and applies each event once and in order to public.subscriptions through one service-only database function. A shared helper decides whether a subscriptions row grants Premium, and ai-astrology-insight uses it while still honouring old premium_astrology_ai rows. Nothing is applied to a database or deployed in this lot.
successCriteria: Migration 20261115090000 adds nilaza_private.revenuecat_webhook_events (RLS on and forced, no client access), nullable provider_event_at, product_id and environment columns on public.subscriptions, and public.nilaza_apply_revenuecat_event executable only by service_role; it returns applied, duplicate, stale or unknown_user and keeps the existing subscriptions RLS.

revenuecat-webhook accepts POST only, compares the Authorization header with REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTH in constant time, caps the body at 64 KB, ignores TEST, anonymous and non-premium events with 200, maps lifecycle events to a status and period end, answers 401/400/405/413/5xx with an error code only and Cache-Control no-store.

supabase/functions/_shared/premium-entitlement.ts exposes isPremiumEntitled and resolveServerTier; ai-astrology-insight reads premium and premium_astrology_ai rows through it and still fails closed when the read fails.
Deno tests for the webhook handler and the helper pass; deno check passes for both functions; backend contract, Supabase readiness, migration ledger, governance and this preflight pass.
untouchedSurfaces: No SQL is run and no migration is applied: the Owner applies 20261115090000 to Singapore only after approving it.
No Edge Function is deployed and no secret is set; REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTH is set by the Owner.
apps/mobile is untouched (SDK, purchase and restore are lot 2); PLAN.md is updated by the lead agent.
The RevenueCat REST API is not called in this lot; reconciling against GET /subscribers needs an Owner key and comes later.
supabase/migration-ledgers/nilaza-singapore-prelaunch-qa.json records only read-back applied versions, so it is not edited.
The existing subscriptions RLS policies and the client table privilege allowlist are not changed; no public table is added.

impact.entryPoint: New Edge Function revenuecat-webhook (verify_jwt false, shared secret); RPC public.nilaza_apply_revenuecat_event; ai-astrology-insight premium check.
impact.dataWrite: After an approved migration and deploy: one row per RevenueCat event id in nilaza_private.revenuecat_webhook_events and an upsert of the user's revenuecat row in public.subscriptions. Nothing is written in this lot.
impact.backendContract: New webhook endpoint for RevenueCat only; ai-astrology-insight responses unchanged, it now also accepts the premium entitlement and cancelled or past-due rows whose period has not ended.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin screen change; the Admin workflow catalog digest for ai-astrology-insight is refreshed.
impact.privacySafety: The webhook stores only the Supabase user id, event id, type, timestamps, product id and store environment; no price, email, IP or subscriber attributes are stored or logged.
impact.observability: Webhook answers carry an outcome code; logs carry only the error code, never the secret or the payload.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; if the migration was applied, drop the RPC and the private table and the three added nullable columns (no existing data depends on them).

Event types, id, app_user_id, original_app_user_id, aliases, entitlement_ids, expiration_at_ms, event_timestamp_ms, period_type, environment, grace_period_expiration_at_ms, TRANSFER fields.
Access is kept during grace period, lost in account hold, while paused and after expiry.

securityReview.authzRls: Event table in nilaza_private with RLS enabled and forced, all client privileges revoked; RPC revoked from public, anon and authenticated, executable by service_role only; subscriptions keeps its own-row read policy and no client write.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Only user id, event id and type, timestamps, product id and store environment are stored; no price, email, subscriber attributes or IP.
securityReview.secretsLogging: REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTH is read from the function environment only, compared by SHA-256 digests in constant time, never logged or echoed; the agent does not read or set it.
securityReview.externalInput: Public endpoint without JWT: shared secret first, POST only, 64 KB body cap, strict JSON parse, UUID-only user id, entitlement and status chosen from fixed lists, timestamps validated.
securityReview.dependencies: No package added; existing std serve and supabase-js imports reused.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Owner approves and applies 20261115090000 to Singapore, deploys revenuecat-webhook with --no-verify-jwt and redeploys ai-astrology-insight, then sets the secret and the RevenueCat webhook URL.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop if a Deno test, deno check or any listed validator fails, or if the migration would need a new public table or a change to existing RLS.

managerTestPath: After the Owner applies the migration, deploys and sets the secret: send the RevenueCat dashboard test event (200, nothing written), then a sandbox purchase by a license tester: the tester's subscriptions row shows premium active with an end date, Astrology AI no longer answers premium_required; resending the same event changes nothing; a wrong secret answers 401.
residualRisk: The webhook trusts the payload instead of re-reading RevenueCat (REST reconciliation needs an Owner key, later lot). TRANSFER events are acknowledged but not applied, so a moved purchase shows up only after the next event or a restore. Refund and pause semantics of expiration_at_ms are taken from the docs and not yet observed on a real sandbox purchase. The Singapore ledger file still lists only 33 versions and is not refreshed here.
